candidate: Native Qwen keypoint map + original-detail identity, followed by unchanged Animate2 graph; remove Klein/source RGB from reference generation.
paired_control_if_candidate_passes: Same prompt/seed/models/graph/identity. Substitute original RGB first frame for skeleton guide; same source conditioning dimensions. Do not select winner by seed.
reference_gate: Frozen defining glasses/curls/beard/face and blue blazer/ivory shirt recognizable >=3/4; plausible source framing/head/hand pose; no headwrap/cartoon/extra subject/limbs. Visible principal joints should be near source guide; estimates support visual review, not override it.
video_gate: Existing frozen RUBRIC.md unchanged: every applicable dimension >=3, >=28/33 frames with defining attributes, no duplicated limb/collapse/extra subject. Separately inspect raw/composite every frame. Recognizable source gestures and timing. A still cannot pass video.
heldout: Only after candidate freeze and development video pass, select genuinely independent licensed recording and freeze four source-only timestamp landmarks before first generated output. >=3/4 landmarks within2frames8fps, plus all other gates. Former signer/private portrait/synthetic cases are development.
stop: If candidate reference fails, stop new GPU inference and report specific limitations. Otherwise matched RGB control and one development video; if video fails, stop. Only a passing video permits one unseen full-pipeline run. No rerolls or new model.
